'''2020 TMW Pods Rikard Eriksen DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rikard Eriksen]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Rikard Eriksen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open This Deal Is Getting Worse A Erikse.txt |Download]]
